info.name: Miqaat Core Identity Authorization
info.description:
## Tokens (no API keys)
Every request inherits `Bearer {{access_token}}`. Sign in with the *Miqaat Identity Federation* collection (folder **1. Sign in**): its select-scope requests store the globals `access_token` (audience authorization, CORE workspace) and `identity_access_token` (audience identity). Tokens last about 10 minutes; re-run select-scope on `401`.
Service-token folders need a single-use `client-authentication+jwt` signed by the calling principal (`federation_service_token`, `bu_service_token`).

## Run order for onboarding
Organisation → Applications → Roles & permissions → Clients (create, origins, callbacks, SECURITY_REVIEW, ACTIVE, Apply in Identity) → Users & assignments. Create requests store `tenant_id`, `bu_id`, `utility_id`, `role_id` and `client_id` for the requests after them.

## Status values
Clients: `PENDING → SECURITY_REVIEW → ACTIVE ⇄ SUSPENDED → RETIRED` (RETIRED is permanent). Tenants, business units, utilities, applications: `active` | `inactive`. Users: `active` | `inactive` | `suspended`. Roles have no status.

item.name: Organisation
item.description: Status: active | inactive. Tenants need CORE; business units BUSINESS_UNIT_MGMT; utilities UTILITY_MGMT; environments CONFIGURATION (create needs CORE).

item.name: Applications
item.description: CONFIGURATION view to list; CORE + CONFIGURATION edit to create. Status is set on create (no update endpoint).

request.description: Owned by a utility (utility_id) or a business unit (bu_id).

item.name: Roles & permissions
item.description: Permission code = <MODULE_CODE>_<ACTION>; actions view, create, edit, delete, approve, export. Roles have no status: revoke permissions or assignments instead.

item.name: Clients
item.description: CONFIGURATION view to read; every write needs a CORE workspace with CONFIGURATION edit. After any write run "Apply in Identity".

request.description: client_type WEB | SPA | MOBILE | SERVICE; authentication_mode EMBEDDED | REDIRECT | EMBEDDED_OR_REDIRECT. Sets client_id to the new client.
back_channel_logout_uri / initiate_login_uri: null removes the value.
Needs at least one callback URI, and one embed origin for EMBEDDED modes (409 CLIENT_CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE).
Irreversible: a retired client can never be changed again (409 CLIENT_RETIRED). Allowed from every status.
Exact scheme://host[:port]; https (http only for localhost with ALLOW_INSECURE_LOCALHOST_URIS=true). Idempotent.
404 ORIGIN_NOT_REGISTERED if absent; 409 CLIENT_CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE for the last origin of an ACTIVE embedded client.
Only one per client: replaces the existing one.
404 URI_NOT_REGISTERED if absent; 409 for the last callback of an ACTIVE client.
Identity endpoint. Token: select-scope with audience identity (global identity_access_token). Applies origin, callback and status changes now instead of after 30 s.

item.name: Users & assignments
item.description: USER_MGMT. User status: active | inactive | suspended. scope_id is null for CORE, else bu_id / utility_id.

request.description: Permission checks deny with USER_INACTIVE. End live sessions with Identity force logout.

item.name: Authorization (BU backend service token)
item.description: Scope AUTHZ_CHECK; the principal may only ask about its own client IDs.

request.description: Deny reasons: CLIENT_NOT_FOUND, CLIENT_NOT_ACTIVE, APPLICATION_INACTIVE, USER_NOT_FOUND, USER_INACTIVE, APPLICATION_ACCESS_DENIED, PERMISSION_DENIED, MODULE_MISMATCH.

item.name: Internal federation (Identity service token)
item.description: Called by Identity Federation only (scope FEDERATION).
